response.text: {"title": "Risks and assumptions", "text": "The main risks include the proposal PDF exceeding the 20-page limit or upload stalling leading to disqualification, REST API integration failures breaching the timeline, and legacy data migration issues undermining the ten-year retention mandate [RSK-001, RSK-002, RSK-003]. To address these, we enforce an 18-page limit for a two-page safety buffer, upload 24 hours before the 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC deadline, request REST API documentation and sandbox specs, build a mock API wrapper, request a sample data extract, and develop automated cleansing and validation scripts [RSK-001, RSK-002, RSK-003]. Several open questions remain regarding templates for twelve forms, migration of signed records by 2027-02-28, an on-premises deployment option, one-hour severity-one incident responses, the REST API technology stack and rate-limiting policy, and the format of the 38,000 legacy records [Q-01, Q-02, Q-03, Q-04, Q-05, Q-06].", "cited_ids": ["RSK-001", "RSK-002", "RSK-003", "Q-01", "Q-02", "Q-03", "Q-04", "Q-05", "Q-06"]}
